summary: Frontend-only test of moving the parts of the homepage 'Our Work' cards in the live editor (admin, /?edit=1) at 1440 and 1920. Cards 0 and 1, five parts each (number-row, category, title, description, explore-label): each one can be selected and shows the right label (Card N — number/Title/Subtitle/Text/Link). Dragging live-move-grip moves only that part, by about 60x20px; the other 9 parts did not move. The arrow follows the Explore label. Clicking the title or the explore label in the editor does not navigate (URL unchanged). After Save the moved positions are the same in the editor, after closing the editor, after reloading while logged in, and on the logged-out public page. All 12 checks (10 parts + 2 arrows) pass within 2px at both widths, and there is no horizontal scroll. The number text can be edited: typing changed '01' to '019' and set the status to unsaved, and Undo put back '01'. The typed number was never saved. With the default layout, the number, row, category, title, text and explore label have the same left x in all 4 cards at 1920, 1280, 820 and 390. The arrow is vertically centred on the label. scrollWidth equals clientWidth at every width. After each save run the content was restored with /app/tests/backup_restore_content.py. The final 'diff' shows no differences and the default-layout check found 0 elements with '--ed-' styles.

issues: When the Explore label is moved, the label ends up about 3px higher than the arrow. Example: the label moved y+18 while the arrow moved y+21 with the same --ed-t. The likely cause is layoutStyle adding alignSelf:flex-start to the moved label inside the inline-flex link (align-items:center), while the arrow stays centred. Cosmetic.

The number row is width:100%, so moving it right pushes its rule line past the card and up to the viewport edge. It is clipped by overflow-x:clip, so there is no scroll. This is expected for a full-width element, but users may expect the line to stay inside the card.

action_items: Optional: make the arrow and a moved Explore label stay vertically aligned. Skip alignSelf:flex-start for items.N.link_label, or give the arrow the same align-self.
critical_code_review_comments: The live-move-grip sits 34px below the selected element. When the element is at the bottom of the viewport the grip can be off-screen. This happened once in automation: a drag at 1920 did nothing until the element was centred. Consider flipping the grip above the element when there is no room below.

In the public view, the .h3 scroll-reveal (translateY 44px, 0.8s) is applied on top of the saved --ed-t. The final position is correct. Measurements taken before the animation ends will be off by up to 44px. Tests must wait for transform:none.
seed_data_creation: None. The save runs changed homepage styles, and these were restored from the backup each time (backup_restore_content.py restore + diff = no DIFF). New revision records from those saves remain in the 'revisions' collection.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run the tests with /usr/local/bin/python3 (it has playwright but not pymongo). Run backup_restore_content.py with python3 (/root/.venv, which has pymongo). Usage: python3 /app/tests/backup_restore_content.py backup|restore|diff. work_card_move_check.py <width> save saves the moves; restore afterwards. Always wait for the reveal transforms on .work-card and .h3 to finish before measuring positions. Editor labels: number-row='Card N — number', category='Title', title='Subtitle', description='Text', explore-label='Link'.
